source_policy.numeric_nutrients: Only import or manually curate from an allowed source with record-level provenance.
source_policy.mixing_rule: Do not silently combine nutrient values from different source records into one food record.
source_policy.license_rule: Respect source licensing and attribution; do not bulk-copy restricted databases.
source_policy.api_secret_rule: Never commit API keys to GitHub.
source_policy.validation: Schema validation, provenance check and plausibility check before production use.
